[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also the recommended and first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "The recommendation for primary excision with a narrow margin has a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21)."
]
